name: Edgefield
gaps: Source query returned 5818 rows; 5811 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are SC RFA Edgefield Parcels (county CAMA join) — Edgefield_McCormick_Greenwood_Web_Map_WFL1 layer 9 (https://services9.arcgis.com/RvqSyw3diI7dTKo5/arcgis/rest/services/Edgefield_McCormick_Greenwood_Web_Map_WFL1/FeatureServer/9). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
tax usable: RFA Edgefield Parcels layer 9 (new this pass) carries county CAMA; 2025-11 vintage. RFA/18 M_Value = Tot_Market only (acres component).
sale usable: Parse Instrmnt_D with %Y%m%d; Considerat is a String. Stale ~2025-11.
owner usable: Owner + mailing public on RFA layer 9 (also Ownership on RFA/18, 19438).
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
SCDOT statewide SC_Parcels requires token — not usable as primary.
